From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>

Subject: Technical deep dive: ML/infra session (60-90 min) — next steps

Hi Sarah / Raj —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a proposed next step: a 60-90 minute technical deep dive with your ML + infra teams so we can walk through integration paths, performance expectations, and a short POC plan.

Key takeaways from discovery:
- Primary use case: model inference for clinical note summarization (near-real-time).
- Expected throughput: ~50 req/s during peak; median sequence length ~512 tokens.
- Data constraints: PHI, want private VPC deployment and KMS integration.
- Success criteria: <150ms P95 latency for 512-token sequences, clear audit logs, and cost target per 1k responses.

Proposed deep-dive agenda (draft):
1) Introductions + goals (5 min)
2) Infra constraints & networking (15 min)
3) Model selection & quantization options (20 min)
4) Serving topology, autoscaling & routing policies (20 min)
5) KV caching, batching, and performance tuning (15 min)
6) Rollout plan + next steps (10 min)

Suggested time slots (PT):
- Tue May 11, 10:00-11:30
- Wed May 12, 10:00-11:30
- Thu May 13, 13:00-14:30

Can you confirm which slot works and who from your side should attend (ML engineer, infra/network, security/compliance)? I’ll loop in our Solutions Engineer Camila to lead the technical run-through and will attach a draft agenda and a short product one-pager.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182
